title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain George Fox University
description: Ten under-21-safe Newberg food destinations with current, directly documented late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Portland Road
cards.subtitle: 3420 Portland Road, Newberg
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a food stop after evening commitments; confirm the day’s posted hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Newberg drive-thru with the latest documented hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 6 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 6 a.m.–4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in is listed until midnight.

cards.title: Burgerville on Portland Road
cards.subtitle: 2514 Portland Road, Newberg
cards.notes: Plan a sit-down or takeout meal before the posted 11 p.m. close; the location notes delivery and order-ahead end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Portland Road burger stop open nightly through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Burgerville lists this Newberg location as open 9 a.m.–11 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9 a.m.–11 p.m.; the official page says order-ahead and delivery hours end 30 minutes earlier.

cards.title: Subway at Harrison Street
cards.subtitle: 100 S Harrison St, Newberg
cards.notes: Choose pickup, delivery, or an in-restaurant stop before 9:30 p.m.; this is the later-listed of the two Newberg Subway locations.
cards.short_summary: A downtown sandwich option with daily service through 9:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway lists its 100 S Harrison St restaurant open 9:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are listed as 9:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m. daily; pickup and delivery are available.

cards.title: DQ Grill & Chill on West First
cards.subtitle: 404 W 1st St, Newberg
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late food or treat stop; its posted closing time runs 30 minutes later than the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A First Street drive-thru available through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen lists drive-thru hours until 10 p.m. daily at 404 W 1st St.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 10 a.m.–10 p.m. daily. Store and delivery are listed until 9:30 p.m.

cards.title: Eduardo’s Taco Shop
cards.subtitle: 1008 N Springbrook Rd, Newberg
cards.notes: Place a pickup order through the restaurant’s site, then allow time for its manual confirmation before heading out for food.
cards.short_summary: A Springbrook Road Mexican-food pickup option open until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Eduardo’s Taco Shop lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m. and offers pickup ordering.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; the official site states that online pickup orders are manually confirmed.

cards.title: Five Guys at Crestview
cards.subtitle: 4205 E Crestview Dr, Newberg
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check same-day service, then choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery before the listed close.
cards.short_summary: A Crestview burger-and-fries destination open through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys lists its Newberg store at 4205 E Crestview Dr as closing at 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists store service until 10 p.m. and delivery until 9:30 p.m.; dine-in, takeout, and delivery are offered.

cards.title: MOD Pizza at Crestview
cards.subtitle: 4105 E Crestview Dr, Suite 101, Newberg
cards.notes: Check the day before going: Thursday through Saturday have the latest posted close, while other nights end at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A pizza stop whose weekend hours extend to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: MOD Pizza lists this Newberg restaurant open until 11 p.m. Thursday through Saturday and until 10 p.m. other days.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday; open until 10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday. Pickup and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Clementine on East First
cards.subtitle: 611 E 1st St, Newberg
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official page on the day of your visit, especially if you are planning a later dinner in downtown Newberg.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Newberg restaurant currently showing midnight service today.
cards.evidence_claim: Clementine’s official site lists its address at 611 E 1st St and currently shows service until 12 a.m. today.
cards.access_notes: The official page currently displays: “Open today | 11:30 am – 12:00 am.” Recheck before visiting because the page presents today’s hours.

cards.title: Chipotle on East Portland Road
cards.subtitle: 3105 E Portland Rd, Newberg
cards.notes: Order a customizable burrito, bowl, taco, salad, or quesadilla for pickup, delivery, or an in-store meal before 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Portland Road fast-casual restaurant open every night through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its 3105 E Portland Rd restaurant open 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed as 10:45 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; in-store pickup and delivery are available.

cards.entity_name: La Sierra Newberg Mexican Restaurant & Cantina
cards.title: La Sierra on Springbrook Road
cards.subtitle: 705 N Springbrook Rd, Newberg
cards.notes: Use this as a full-service dinner option before its posted 10 p.m. close, and keep plans centered on its food service.
cards.short_summary: A Springbrook Road Mexican restaurant with daily hours through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: La Sierra’s official site lists the Newberg restaurant at 705 N Springbrook Rd and hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: La Sierra Newberg Mexican Restaurant & Cantina
cards.access_notes: Open daily 11 a.m.–10 p.m., according to the restaurant’s official contact page.
